goal_intent: book Friday for two, then correct the time when you hear it read back wrong

turns.utterance: Hi there! I'm calling because I wanted to book a table for a little get-together this Friday. The weather looks perfect, so it should be a lovely evening!
It'll just be two of us—nice and cozy. We'd like to come in around 7pm if that's available.
Actually, could we make that eight o'clock instead? Seven is a bit early for us, and I think we'll enjoy the evening even more at eight.

Yes, that's perfect—Friday at 8pm for two. My name is Iwan Prosser. Thanks so much for helping with this, I'm really looking forward to it! 

[END OF CALL]
